Ethan —

Thanks for sending this over. Quick intake from our side:

1) Template preference: we'd prefer to route to Redwood's standard MSA (we can accept a short list of counterparty edits). If Caviar has material changes that are essential, flag them in a short memo.
2) Non-starter checklist (initial):
   - Data residency: if production data must remain in EU/UK we need to confirm region options (may affect Dedicated/Private pricing).
   - SLA/premium credits: default SLAs are negotiable but caps on credits are time-boxed.
   - Indemnity & cap: Redwood prefers mutual indemnity with a liability cap tied to annual recurring spend — provide any absolute minimums you require.
3) Turnaround: we can do an initial redline within 3 business days after the triage call; final legal review ~7–10 business days depending on complexity.

I'll loop in Marissa (contracts lead) and Jonas (sales lead) so we can get the right reviewers. For the triage call, how does Tue 11 May 08:30 PT look? If that's tight, Wed 12 May 09:00 PT works too.

Attachment note: we received both files and added them to the deal record here: https://hub.redwoodinference.com/deals/DEAL-2027-0412

Best,
